resolve_lmstudio_effort_basic: resolve a reasoning_config dict into an LM Studio compatible reasoning_effort string
resolve_lmstudio_effort_disabled: resolve reasoning_effort to none when reasoning_config has enabled set to false
resolve_lmstudio_effort_alias: resolve toggle style off or on aliases to none or medium effort values
resolve_lmstudio_effort_clamp: clamp the resolved effort against the model allowed_options and return none if unsupported
resolve_lmstudio_effort_default: return medium as the default reasoning_effort when reasoning_config is absent or empty
